```sql
WITH tenant_customers AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
customer_orders AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           o.total_cents,
           o.created_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id,
           sum(co.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)            AS order_count,
           max(co.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM customer_orders co
     GROUP BY co.customer_id
)
SELECT tc.id,
       tc.email,
       tc.company,
       tc.country_code,
       a.revenue,
       a.order_count,
       a.last_order_at
  FROM agg a
  JOIN tenant_customers tc ON tc.id = a.customer_id
 WHERE a.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND a.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY a.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De tenantfilter wordt nu vóór de aggregatie toegepast, zodat alleen orders van de tenant worden gelezen in plaats van de hele orders-tabel. De `DISTINCT ON`-sortering is vervangen door `max(created_at)`, wat dezelfde laatste bestelling oplevert zonder extra sortering. Kolommen, filters en `ORDER BY` blijven gelijk; bij gelijke omzet is de volgorde net als in het origineel niet gegarandeerd.
